'''Lazna Delothrea''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. A captain within the [[Knights of Zakuul]], she participated in the [[Battle of Asylum]] in [[3631 BBY]]. During the battle she engaged [[Koth Vortena]] and [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]], but was defeated and killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Lazna Delothrea appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''{{'s}} "Chapter 8: Return."
